title: 第42章 第八星痕深渊之心第41章 海底遗宫
lines: 第42章第八星痕·深渊之心
冷蓝星火先钻进掌心。
铜星坠贴着胸口猛地一震，坠面星图一格格亮起。石门正中的深渊链锁符文同时被点亮，一线分成八道，顺着门面爬开。
下一瞬，门心裂出一线冷蓝。
光痕分叉，咬住八条链锁。
整扇黑曜石门无声裂成八块，朝两侧滑开。
门后，祭坛大厅彻底露了出来。
四壁漆黑，石缝里嵌着碎星晶。地面满是深渊链锁符文阵，八条主链从四面压向中央祭坛。祭坛上方悬着一道环形封印台，冷蓝星火裹着一枚暗蓝晶核，三息一动，节拍和铜星坠一模一样。
可封印已经烂了。
八条主链，断了四条。
断口塞满灰黑碎屑，外头又裹着一层暗紫逆流，正一点点结成光茧。光茧贴在封印台底部，每鼓一次，旁边的副链就崩一截。祭坛下方那条旧核老裂隙也已经张开，污染正顶着往上涌。
裂隙边缘插着黑星火符石。
更深处，娜迦蹲在那里，像条守坑的毒蛇。
洛晖只扫了一眼，直接开口。
“分三路。”
他一把扯下铜星坠，蓝火灌了进去。坠面星图轰然展开，整座祭坛大厅的结构硬生生压进他脑子里。
“绮雯，堵裂隙。别让她把下面那团东西拉出来。”
“卡洛琳，推进核别当船了，切共鸣放大。剩下的星盐全灌进去。等我激活本核，你把脉冲给我砸去东南角。”
“我开封印台。”
一句比一句快。
没给人商量的空。
绮雯先动。
她闪到左侧，刚落地，肩胛那道暗紫裂口又往外撕开一截，血顺着黑甲往下淌。她眼皮都没抬一下，反手抽刀，刃心那缕蓝色净火先贴上裂隙入口的灰烬防护膜。
“你最好快点。”她嗓音发哑，“我这条胳膊快过保了。”
洛晖嗤了一声。
“省着点用，坏了没售后。”
绮雯没理他。
三道影绸甩出，钉死裂隙外围。第一刀捅下去，净火烧开膜层一道细口。第二层刚露出来，两头裂脊兽已经从侧面扑出。
第一道影绸只撑了三息。
第二道又拦四息。
第三道被鳍刺撕开的同时，绮雯已经一刀扎进第三层膜里，刀尖直撞第八枚黑星火符石的供能芯。净火灌进去，符石当场炸开，暗紫碎屑喷了满裂隙。
裂隙中段，娜迦抬起左臂。
她右臂半废，左臂上却扣着一只暗紫晶核手套。五指后连着五条灰烬供能管线。
她一握拳。
五条管线瞬间绷紧。
裂隙底下那团灰烬核心前体，被她硬生生往东南角扯出去四尺。
四尺。
刚好脱出封印台最后一道守护符文的压制范围。
光茧鼓动骤然加快。
“她在拉偏核心！”绮雯厉声喝道，刀锋又往下送了半寸。
洛晖已经冲到了封印台前。
十步外，他脚下猛地一顿。
content_en:
Chapter 42 The Eighth Star Trace·Heart of the Abyss
Leng Lan Xinghuo got into the palm first.
The copper star pendant shook violently against his chest, and the star chart on the pendant's face lit up. The abyss chain rune in the center of the stone door was lit at the same time, and the line was divided into eight lines, crawling along the door.
The next moment, a line of cold blue appeared in the center of the door.
The light traces bifurcated, biting eight chains.
The entire obsidian door silently cracked into eight pieces and slid open to both sides.
Behind the door, the altar hall was completely exposed.
The walls were dark, with broken star crystals embedded in the cracks of the stone. The ground is covered with abyssal chain rune formations, with eight main chains pressing toward the central altar from all sides. A ring-shaped sealing platform hangs above the altar, with a dark blue crystal core wrapped in cold blue sparks. It moves with three breaths, and the rhythm is exactly the same as the copper star pendant.
But the seal is broken.
Of the eight main chains, four were broken.
The fracture is filled with gray and black debris, and is covered with a layer of dark purple countercurrent, forming a cocoon of light little by little. The light cocoon is attached to the bottom of the sealing platform. Every time it bulges, a section of the secondary chain next to it collapses. The old nuclear fissure under the altar has also opened, and pollution is rising upwards.
There is a black spark runestone inserted at the edge of the crack.
Deeper down, Naga squatted there like a poisonous snake guarding its pit.
Luo Hui only glanced at it and spoke directly.
"Split into three ways."
He pulled off the copper star pendant and poured the blue fire into it. The falling star map suddenly unfolded, and the structure of the entire altar hall was forced into his mind.
"Qiwen, seal the crack. Don't let her pull out the lump underneath."
"Caroline, advance the nuclear analysis to become the ship, and amplify the resonance. Pour in all the remaining star salt. When I activate the core, you can send the pulse to the southeast corner."
"I'll open the sealing platform."
Each sentence is faster than the other.
There is no room for discussion.
Qiwen moved first.
She dodged to the left side, and as soon as she landed, the dark purple crack on her shoulder blade tore open again, and blood dripped down her black armor. Without even raising her eyelids, she drew the knife with her backhand, and the blue pure fire at the center of the blade was first attached to the ash protective film at the entrance of the crack.
"You better hurry up." Her voice was hoarse. "My arm is almost out of bounds."
Luo Hui snorted.
"Use it sparingly. If it breaks, there will be no after-sales service."
Qiwen ignored him.
Three shadow silks were thrown out, nailing the outer edge of the crack. With the first stab of the knife, the pure fire burned open a thin opening in the film. As soon as the second layer was exposed, two split-spine beasts had already pounced out from the side.
The first shadow silk only lasted three breaths.
The second path blocks four more breaths.
At the same time that the third one was torn apart by the fin thorns, Qiwen had already pierced the third membrane with a knife, and the tip of the knife hit the energy supply core of the eighth Black Spark Runestone. When the pure fire poured in, the rune stones exploded on the spot, and dark purple debris sprayed out all over the cracks.
In the middle of the rift, Naga raised her left arm.
Her right arm is half disabled, but there is a dark amethyst core glove on her left arm. There are five ash energy supply lines connected behind the five fingers.
She made a fist.
The five pipelines tightened instantly.
The ash core precursor at the bottom of the crack was forcefully pulled out four feet to the southeast corner.
Four feet.
Just out of the suppression range of the last protective rune of the sealing platform.
The beating of the light cocoon suddenly accelerated.
"She's pulling away from the core!" Qiwen shouted sharply, and the blade was lowered another half inch.
Luo Hui has already rushed to the sealing platform.
Ten steps away, his feet suddenly stopped.
